data.one_liner: A Dart client to integrate with Azure's Application Insights service.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to push telemetry items, traces, errors, and dependency calls into your Azure Application Insights instance. It includes support for buffering processors, tracking crashes, and an HTTP client middleware to capture network requests automatically.
use_when: You need to monitor Flutter or Dart application performance and usage using Azure Application Insights
You want to capture crashes and unhandled exceptions and send them to Azure
You want to track HTTP dependency calls automatically
avoid_when: You are using a different analytics or error-reporting backend like Firebase or Sentry
You do not use Azure services for backend telemetry
strengths: Deep integration with Azure Application Insights telemetry items
Includes a TelemetryHttpClient for automatic dependency tracking
Supports configurable buffering and context properties
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of connection strings and setup
Limited to Azure Application Insights backend
data.setup_notes: Obtain a connection string from your Application Insights resource overview in the Azure portal and construct a TelemetryClient with a processor.
